title: Scanning configuration
statement: Let $z$ be a Boolean input list, let $\phi$ be a phase, and let $r,i$ be natural numbers with $i\le |z|$. The associated two-work-tape machine configuration has input $z$, first-read state carrying $\phi$, input-head position determined by $i$, an empty value tape, a mark tape containing $r$ consecutive true cells, work-head position $r$, and empty output.
caveat: The definitions of the configuration-building functions and tape encodings are absent, so the precise input-head and tape-construction conventions are not supplied.
